items.excerpt: Figma distills what senior design and product leaders said at Config Leadership Collective about running teams through the AI shift: favor adaptability and hands-on experimentation over rigid process, and protect craft and human judgment. The through-line: expertise is no longer having the answer, it's knowing which answer works best in context.

The free, open-source Godot engine is restricting AI-generated code contributions, which Creative Bloq frames as a reality check for vibe coders: AI output still needs human review, provenance, and accountability before it can ship in shared creative tools.

Mixos is a new browser-based WebGPU tool for painting 4K PBR textures directly onto 3D models or remixing a library of 2,600+ CC0 materials, with credit-based generative AI for auto-texturing models and generating PBR materials from text descriptions. Exports target DCC apps and game engines.

Inbibo's Adonis 2.1 adds AdonisML, a machine learning edition of its soft-tissue simulation add-on for Maya and Houdini: an ML Deformer and SmartTissue system train lightweight approximations of complex tissue setups so animators get high-fidelity secondary motion at interactive speed.

DEVELOP3D examines Jeff Bezos's Prometheus project — an AI venture aiming to build an 'artificial general engineer' — and asks what it means for CAD: could AI compress lengthy engineering design projects into far shorter timeframes, and what happens to the tools engineers use today?

Figma engineer Jerry Wu walks through Weave Tools, pre-built AI tools that package the power of node-based Weave Workflows into a convenient interface you can run directly from the Figma canvas — covering the Tools tab, applying tools, and understanding the node workflows underneath.
